about: The Editor's last Claude review (house style, facts, tone, premium visuals).
summary: No Never-list breaches in the captions, but the Doomsday reactive post (2026-11-24-reactive1) falls short of the premium visual standard and is held; video frames could not be inspected and only that post had images.
points: 2026-11-24-reactive1 thumbnail: no product, large empty gradient with a muddy grey-green band in the middle that lowers contrast and looks washed out, and the URL is tiny. Fix: use a strong black-and-green Doomsday-style background with a sharp, large golf bag or clubs, and 2-4 big words such as 'ASSEMBLE THE BAG' kept in the middle 4:5.
2026-11-24-reactive1 card: the artwork is narrower than the canvas, leaving lighter green side bars that look like a layout error. Fix: make the artwork fill the full width.

2026-11-24-reactive1 card: the grey 'Compared across multiple UK retailers' line and the green 'Full Swing. Not full price.' line are small and low-contrast on green, so they are hard to read on a phone. Fix: make them larger and use white or light text.

2026-11-24-reactive1: card says 'BUILD YOUR BAG FOR LESS' with a starfield and grid, but the thumbnail says 'ASSEMBLE THE BAG' on a plain gradient and the hook is 'Assemble the bag'. Make the card, thumbnail and video share one line and one look. Colours (black and green) do suit Doomsday.

2026-11-24-reactive1: could not extract video frames (no ffmpeg in this environment), so the video's pace, hook and mid-frames are not judged. Caption claim 'checked every 6 hours' should be confirmed against site data. sound is null, so the video has no sound.
All posts except 2026-11-24-reactive1: no card, thumbnail or video images were supplied, so their visuals were not checked. Re-run with images before approving.

2026-11-25-tiein2: YouTube title is cut off mid-word ('golf mode') and over 60 characters, and has '#Ad' reduced to 'Ad'. Rewrite it short. Fix the YouTube description, where #golf and #golfuk appear twice.
2026-11-25-tiein2: 'Over 300 models' and '£524 on the Mizuno Pro S-4 Irons' must match the site's own price-history data.

Several posts (11-25-wed, 12-02-wed, 11-27-fri, 12-04-fri) have a TikTok caption close to the Instagram one but no product, which is fine. Check that the TikTok variants don't carry keyword lists.
